items.title: XMTrading promotion ecosystem
items.summary: Competition, loyalty points and referral mechanics are presented together on the localized promotion hub.
items.takeaway: Build an always-on promotion ecosystem instead of relying on a single deposit bonus.

items.title: Five-tier XMP loyalty program
items.summary: Five tiers, up to 3x points, withdrawable balance, trading bonus and VIP rewards; XMP expires after one year.
items.takeaway: Progressive tiers and reward choice can make delayed redemption more attractive.

items.title: HFM Road to Legend loyalty journey
items.summary: TRP points, missions, boosters, levels and lifestyle rewards create a gamified retention system.
items.takeaway: Use missions and progress visibility to create repeat engagement, not only prize appeal.

items.title: Weekly demo, daily and crypto competitions
items.summary: Free weekly demo competitions, paid daily arenas and weekend crypto competitions are distributed through partners.
items.takeaway: Use a demo challenge to activate education leads before asking for an FTD.

items.title: Localized Thai trading competitions
items.summary: Thai-language partner campaign focuses on recurring participation, skills and leaderboard recognition.
items.takeaway: Pair local-language education with a repeatable community competition format.

items.title: No joining, deposit or trading bonus
items.summary: Exness explicitly rejects bonus-led acquisition and points users toward affiliate and IB economics.
items.takeaway: Trading conditions, withdrawal experience and trust can outperform bonus-led positioning.

items.title: Own the Moment World Cup social activity
items.summary: Like-and-share activity around an official World Cup promotion post; the terms ended on 15 July 2026.
items.takeaway: Event-led social mechanics can lift reach, but campaign expiry must be visible in reporting.

strategies.name: Local Market Intelligence Studio
strategies.objective: Turn observed competitor signals into localized content and landing-page tests.
strategies.decision: Approve one 30-day content pilot per priority market.

strategies.name: Activation & Retention Missions
strategies.objective: Test mission-based onboarding and progressive rewards against a non-incentivized cohort.
strategies.decision: Confirm reward ceiling and fraud controls.

strategies.name: Creator & IB Governance Engine
strategies.objective: Give partners approved claims, templates, tracking links and a quality scorecard.
strategies.decision: Assign partner-data owner and review cadence.
